title: L5: simulated-explanations run of A-c on dev-100 + final slice (bound ~1,600 + final), optional
description:
## Purpose

OPTIONAL, separate, clearly labeled experiment: measure the value of rubric communication with SIMULATED stakeholder feedback. Not a property of the dataset; the headline is the labels-only run (L1-L3).

## Scope

Harness arm A-c with the L0 simulated comments, 3 rounds x 150 on dev-100, then the frozen bundle on the final slice. Compare with labels-only A from L1-L3.

## Request bound and cost cap

Bound ~1,600 (dev) + ~600 (final slice) Jev requests (use the printed bound). Cap: ~$2.20; cumulative (incl. L0) must stay <= $10. Fresh ledger; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class.

## Definition of done

A-c (simulated explanations) vs A (labels only) on dev curves and final slice with paired bootstrap; reported as simulated in the publish addendum.
